prior_evidence_disclosure: Transaction-level Form 4 cluster-plus-opening-reaction candidates were measured in section 6.208. This family removes both cluster and price-reaction conditioning and tests medium-horizon drift after exact open-market purchases. Thresholds and holds below are frozen before this family's PnL.
hypothesis: PIT-safe open-market insider purchases contain medium-horizon issuer-specific information that does not require a same-session gap or first-five-minute confirmation.

samples.oos: 2025-2026 prohibited; no row or feature from that window may be consumed

event_contract.source: Official SEC quarterly Insider Transactions Data Sets joined to cached acceptance timestamps by exact accession
event_contract.availability: Assign each acceptance timestamp to the first full PIT trading session whose 09:15 ET cutoff is strictly later; entry can occur only at exact 09:35 on that assigned session.
event_contract.issuer: SEC bulk SUBMISSION issuer CIK, never the reporting-owner/entity CIK from the submissions cache
event_contract.purchase: NONDERIV_TRANS transaction code P and acquired/disposed code A
event_contract.sale: NONDERIV_TRANS transaction code S and acquired/disposed code D
event_contract.dollar_notional: Positive finite shares times positive finite price; missing price contributes zero dollars and remains in transaction coverage counts.
event_contract.aggregation: Sum all exact Form 4 accessions assigned to the same issuer/session; purchase_accessions counts exact accessions containing at least one qualifying P/A transaction.
event_contract.excluded: Derivative transactions, non-P/S codes, amendments absent from the source event inventory, and all post-2024 rows

market_contract.universe: Quarterly PIT market-cap top500 representative per issuer CIK, then current price>=5 and lagged ADV20>=10m
market_contract.exit: Exact 15:55 on the hold-th session, entry session counted as day 1
market_contract.stage_boundary: Development and validation are independent $100k books. Admit an event only when its complete frozen hold exit exists inside that stage; no position or equity carries across the boundary.
market_contract.benchmark: Report broad-PIT/SPY benchmark context separately; benchmark performance cannot select a candidate

portfolio_contract.overlap: No new position while issuer CIK is active
portfolio_contract.capacity: Entry notional <=1% of current PIT ADV20
portfolio_contract.missing_entry: Skip without replacement unless exact 09:35 exists
portfolio_contract.missing_exit: Retain until next exact 09:35 or 15:55, whichever occurs first

selection_rule.ranking: Highest base-4bps Sharpe among candidates passing every development gate
selection_rule.tie_break: Higher stress8 Sharpe, then larger entry count, then shorter hold
selection_rule.selection_isolation: Select exactly once on development. Validation may pass or kill that rule but cannot substitute a runner-up.

audit_requirements: Report event/accession coverage, candidate counts, both costs, yearly PnL, dollar and percentage DD, concentration, turnover, exposure, missing marks, and long entries.
Rebuild portfolio overlap, costs, capacity, gross cap, exits, and compounding causally; no PnL subtraction or refill shortcut.
Separate development rule selection from validation trade results.
Do not use old manual/restricted 62 for issuer selection and do not consume 2025-2026 rows.
